finding: Published Script code hit a record-read failure trap. Lowering had merged distinct surface record types by storage layout, and the binder left ambiguous descriptors private; field reads nevertheless require AOT descriptor identity.
repair: Add an optional frontend record-identity partition to lowering. Managed JIT records use exact surface type contracts as partition keys; private records retain physical interning. Reject all ambiguous imported record identities, including read-only uses.
timingLimit: The earlier 121s observation includes debugger launch and is not a measurement of compiler execution alone.
